children: ), the financial holding company for Oriental Bank, announced today the appointment of Mari Evelyn Rodríguez as Chief Operating Officer of OFG Bancorp, effective January 1, 2027. In this role, she will report directly to José R. Fernández, OFG’s Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, and oversee the company’s strategy and operations.

“This appointment reflects OFG’s continued focus on strengthening its executive leadership and developing leaders who can advance the Company’s long-term strategy of being a digital bank with a human touch,” said Mr. Fernández. “Mari Evelyn’s broader responsibilities will leverage her many years of experience in the financial services industry as OFG continues to execute its mission to deliver progress to its customers, employees, shareholders and communities.”

Ms. Rodríguez has been with OFG since May 2023, serving as Chief Retail Banking Officer. Before joining OFG, she was the CEO of Marsh McLennan’s Puerto Rico Office, a commercial insurance brokerage firm, from 2017 to 2023. Previously, she served in various leadership roles at Oriental Bank and other banking institutions from 2006 to 2016.

“Mari Evelyn has been key in growing Oriental Bank’s retail banking business since rejoining the company in 2023, and her collaboration has been instrumental in accomplishing Oriental’s digital banking strategy. I look forward to continuing to work with her in this new role,” said Mr. Fernández.

Now in its 62nd year in business, OFG Bancorp is a diversified financial holding company that operates under U.S., Puerto Rico and U.S. Virgin Islands banking laws and regulations. Its three principal subsidiaries, Oriental Bank, Oriental Financial Services and Oriental Insurance, provide a wide range of retail and commercial banking, lending and wealth management products, services, and technology, primarily in Puerto Rico and U.S. Virgin Islands. Our mission is to make progress possible for our customers, employees, shareholders, and the communities we serve. Visit us at www.ofgbancorp.com.
